thread:
sam (Design): quick check 1— thinking of making the Create key panel a detachable drawer that stays open for 60s so users can copy/download. mock: https://imgur.com/ghi789. want opinions on UX + copy.

jules (Frontend): detachable drawer sounds doable. we'll keep secret in memory only and clear on close or after 60s. need to ensure focus returns to the key row.

lee (A11y): drawer must be role=dialog, trap focus, and announce timing: "This secret will be hidden in 60 seconds." Make undo toast keyboard-focusable and use aria-live for copy/revoke messages.

marta (Product): ken, does support see confusion about losing keys?

ken (Support): yep. Many tickets where users clicked Done and thought key was lost. A short re-open window would cut tickets. Also people misinterpret 'revoke' as irreversible delete.

sam (Design): propose revoke copy: headline "Revoke API key" + subline "Stops the key immediately. Restorable within 24 hours." plus KB link and an Undo toast for 30s.

jules (Frontend): will implement Undo via toast button that calls restore endpoint. also add rotate option with checkbox: "Enable 1-hour overlap" and a textual timeline for SR users.

lee (A11y): timeline needs textual fallback: "Old key active until [time]." sliders must have stepper inputs. icons require accessible names. Ensure tooltip contrast >= 4.5:1.

marta (Product): agree on defaults: no overlap for basic users, suggest overlap for orgs. note: call out security/billing tradeoffs in copy.

sam (Design): will update mocks with drawer re-open affordance, revoke wording, and overlap checkbox.

jules (Frontend): starting branch feat/keys-drawer. will add aria-describedby on secret, set focus to Copy button, and ping @lee for review.

deploy-bot: build queued for branch "feat/keys-drawer"  build 7923 started. :rocket:

ken (Support): I'll draft KB: "Retrieving a key after creation" and "What revoke means" and share copy options.

lee (A11y): final nit: don't auto-close modal for screen-reader users; allow manual close for at least 3s after actions.

sam (Design): thanks all 1— will post updated screenshot when ready. :thumbsup:
